brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset: Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, PNG, landscape approximately 16:9.
Generate a new thumbnail in the attached reference's approved black/lime ink and brush style. The input is a style reference ONLY. Do not reuse its player, name, date, scores or claims.
Subject: an illustrated orange basketball and a few abstract hand-drawn court lines to the right. No humans, no hands, no player faces, no uniforms or logos. Do not portray any specific game, winning basket or match result.
Palette: dark #151A18, lime #CCF43B, off-white text. Bold Japanese headline typography, hand-made ink textures and broad brush strokes. Sparse and spacious composition with clear text/illustration separation, approximately 6% padding.
Exact text, no other words or scores:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.10.25"
"B.PREMIER・B.ONE"
"試合結果"
"公式記録の"
"確定待ち"
"記事掲載情報：10/26 02:23時点"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Make 試合結果 the bold white headline and 公式記録の / 確定待ち a large clearly legible lime two-line statement of equal importance immediately below. The status is PENDING, not a completed match-score announcement. Date 2026.10.25 is the match date, and the smaller article timestamp is 10/26 02:23. Bottom AI disclosure text must be readable. Keep every character within the image, never crop text or the basketball.

qa_notes.text_and_numbers: 出力画像の全9文字列を目視照合。対象日2026.10.25、記事時点10/26 02:23、リーグ一致。

qa_notes.likeness_or_no_named_person: 人物・顔・手なし。ボールと抽象コートのみ。
qa_notes.layout: 約16:9。文字・ボールが画面内に収まり、判読できる。
